CAS — 33086-27-0; 6336-50-1. ATC — H03BA03. ATC Vet — QH03BA03. Profile Benzylthiouracil is a thiourea antithyroid drug. It is given by mouth in the treatment of hyperthyroidism (p.2165) in an initial dose of 150 to 200 mg daily, reducing to a maintenance dose of 100 mg daily; it is given in divided doses, preferably with food.
